143: // Return the real index and step values for a slice when applied to a sequence of
144: // the given length, resolving missing components, negative values and values off
145: // the end of the sequence.
146: void mp_obj_slice_indices(mp_obj_t self_in, mp_int_t length, mp_bound_slice_t *result) {
147:     mp_obj_slice_t *self = MP_OBJ_TO_PTR(self_in);
148:     mp_int_t start, stop, step;
149: 
150:     if (self->step == mp_const_none) {
151:         step = 1;
152:     } else {
153:         step = mp_obj_get_int(self->step);
154:         if (step == 0) {
155:             mp_raise_ValueError(MP_ERROR_TEXT("slice step can't be zero"));
156:         }
157:     }
158: 
159:     if (step > 0) {
160:         // Positive step
161:         if (self->start == mp_const_none) {
162:             start = 0;
163:         } else {
164:             start = mp_obj_get_int(self->start);
165:             if (start < 0) {
166:                 start += length;
167:             }
168:             start = MIN(length, MAX(start, 0));
169:         }
170: 
171:         if (self->stop == mp_const_none) {
172:             stop = length;
173:         } else {
174:             stop = mp_obj_get_int(self->stop);
175:             if (stop < 0) {
176:                 stop += length;
177:             }
178:             stop = MIN(length, MAX(stop, 0));
179:         }
180:     } else {
181:         // Negative step
182:         if (self->start == mp_const_none) {
183:             start = length - 1;
184:         } else {
185:             start = mp_obj_get_int(self->start);
186:             if (start < 0) {
187:                 start += length;
188:             }
189:             start = MIN(length - 1, MAX(start, -1));
190:         }
191: 
192:         if (self->stop == mp_const_none) {
193:             stop = -1;
194:         } else {
195:             stop = mp_obj_get_int(self->stop);
196:             if (stop < 0) {
197:                 stop += length;
198:             }
199:             stop = MIN(length - 1, MAX(stop, -1));
200:         }
201:     }
202: 
203:     result->start = start;
204:     result->stop = stop;
205:     result->step = step;
206: }
